narrative.title: Decision narrative
narrative.whyUnavailable: No defensible impact statement is available.
narrative.causeUnavailable: Cause is not established by the available evidence.
narrative.responseUnavailable: No action is recommended from this evidence alone.

battery.title: Long-term pack health remains measurable and actionable
battery.description: Health, degradation, range confidence, charging stress, thermal impact, and cycle exposure are summarized before the deeper evidence.
battery.healthDetail: Current modeled health relative to the original usable pack.
battery.degradationDetail: Annualized capacity change inferred from available history.
battery.projectionDetail: Projected time to the common warranty-health threshold.
battery.projectionUnavailable: More stable history is required for a trustworthy projection.
battery.cyclesDetail: Equivalent full cycles accumulated across charging activity.
battery.rangeConfidenceHighDetail: {{count}} historical range samples support a stable {{years}}-year threshold forecast.
battery.rangeConfidenceDevelopingDetail: {{count}} historical range samples are available; more history will tighten the forecast.
battery.rangeConfidenceLimitedDetail: Only {{count}} usable range samples are available; treat projections as directional.
battery.chargingStressDetail: {{fast}} fast-charge sessions; {{depth}} average depth of discharge.
battery.thermalImpactDetail: Lower exposure is better; sustained high temperatures increase pack wear.
battery.thermalImpactUnavailable: More temperature history is required to estimate thermal exposure.
battery.provenance: Calculated from battery-health snapshots, charging history, and the latest available BMS telemetry.

narrative.snapshotSummary: {{date}}: {{health}} state of health with {{capacity}} estimated usable capacity.
narrative.snapshotMethod: Direct capacity and range snapshot retained by battery analytics.
narrative.whatChanged: Modeled pack health is {{health}}, with {{rate}} annualized degradation across the available history.
narrative.healthyImpact: Stable capacity preserves usable range and reduces near-term service uncertainty.
narrative.snapshotBasis: {{count}} retained battery-health snapshots support this assessment.
narrative.projectionBasis: The degradation projection passed the page stability bounds.
narrative.projectionLimitedBasis: The projection is withheld because the available trend did not pass stability bounds.
narrative.serviceResponse: Arrange an independent battery-health review and preserve the supporting snapshots.
narrative.chargingResponse: Review repeated fast charging and deep discharge exposure before the pattern continues.
narrative.monitorResponse: Continue monitoring capacity, thermal exposure, and charging stress as new snapshots arrive.
narrative.causeLimitation: Capacity history can identify a trend but does not diagnose the physical cause of degradation.
narrative.temperatureLimitation: Temperature history is insufficient to score thermal exposure.
narrative.projectionLimitation: Time-to-threshold projections remain directional until a stable trend is available.
narrative.evidenceLimit: Supporting evidence is limited to the five most recent retained snapshots.
narrative.analyticsMethod: Models state of health and degradation from retained battery snapshots.
narrative.chargingMethod: Measures fast-charge, depth-of-discharge, and cycle exposure from recorded sessions.

energy.title: Consumption, efficiency, and cost in one operating view
energy.description: The selected window combines measured drive consumption, charging cost coverage, idle drain, and projected usage.
energy.noDataDescription: Complete a drive or charging session to establish efficiency and cost baselines.
energy.efficiencyAttention: Efficiency is outside the preferred band
energy.efficiencyAttentionDescription: Compare the linked temperature, speed, and route evidence; this page does not attribute a cause.
energy.idleDrainAttentionDescription: The 90-day parked, non-charging average is {{value}} per day.
energy.savingsDescription: Estimated savings versus the configured gas-equivalent model are {{value}}.
energy.costPremiumTitle: Recorded electric cost exceeds the gas model
energy.costPremiumDescription: Recorded charging cost is {{value}} above the configured gas-equivalent model for this distance.
energy.costCoverageDescription: {{priced}} of {{total}} returned sessions include recorded cost; savings and cost projections are withheld.
energy.sessionCapTitle: Charging history reached the analysis cap
energy.sessionCapDescription: The latest 100 sessions are shown; older sessions may be outside cost and pattern analysis.
energy.lossUnavailableDescription: Independent wall-input and battery-retained energy are absent from the session contract, so no loss percentage is fabricated.
energy.consumptionDetail: Measured traction energy in the selected drive aggregate.
energy.efficiencyDetail: Average energy consumed per display-distance unit.
energy.idleDrainDetail: Average parked, non-charging loss across the separate 90-day source window.
energy.chargingLossDetail: Wall input and battery-retained energy are not independently available.
energy.projectedUsageDetail: Straight-line projection from measured consumption in the selected window.
energy.provenance: Drive consumption comes from SI daily aggregates; costs from returned charging sessions; idle drain from 90-day FSM and signal history. Charging loss remains unsupported.

narrative.dailyMethod: Daily aggregate of measured drive energy and distance.
narrative.sessionMethod: Direct charging-session energy and recorded cost.
narrative.whatChanged: {{energy}} of measured drive energy across {{days}} daily records, with {{cost}} in recorded charging cost.
narrative.impact: Energy intensity and cost coverage determine operating exposure and whether projections are decision-ready.
narrative.dailyBasis: {{count}} daily drive aggregates contain measured energy.
narrative.costBasis: {{priced}} of {{total}} returned charging sessions include recorded cost.
narrative.monitorResponse: No immediate response is indicated; continue collecting drive and charging evidence.
narrative.sourceLimitation: {{count}} supporting data source is unavailable, so this assessment is partial.
narrative.costLimitation: Cost totals exclude sessions without a recorded price.
narrative.windowLimitation: Idle drain uses a separate 90-day source window and is not attributed to a specific cause.
narrative.driveMethod: Sums canonical measured drive energy and distance in the active analysis window.
narrative.costMethod: Sums only cost values persisted on returned charging sessions.
narrative.idleMethod: Computes parked, non-charging battery change over the separate 90-day source window.

vehicles.title: Availability and readiness across the fleet
vehicles.description: Live connectivity, departure readiness, utilization, software consistency, and service attention are consolidated before vehicle-level detail.
vehicles.offlineDescription: Live state could not be resolved. Verify connectivity before issuing commands.
vehicles.lowBatteryDescription: Review charging readiness before the next scheduled departure.
vehicles.totalDetail: Vehicles currently registered in this TeslaSync workspace.
vehicles.onlineDetail: Vehicles with a current state response available.
vehicles.readinessDetail: Vehicles reporting live state with at least 20% battery.
vehicles.utilizationDetail: {{active}} of {{total}} registered vehicles are driving or charging now.
vehicles.softwareDetail: {{reported}} of {{online}} live vehicles reported a software version.
vehicles.softwareMixedDescription: Review rollout consistency before diagnosing behavior that differs between vehicles.
vehicles.serviceDetail: High- or critical-severity work orders requiring review: {{urgent}}.
vehicles.serviceAttentionDescription: High- or critical-severity maintenance is still open in Fleet Operations.
vehicles.serviceUnavailableDescription: Fleet availability and live state remain visible, but maintenance work orders could not be loaded.
vehicles.serviceUnavailableMetric: Work-order data is unavailable; live fleet data remains usable.
vehicles.batteryDetail: Mean state of charge across vehicles with live state.
vehicles.chargingDetail: Vehicles actively reporting a charging state.
vehicles.provenance: Based on the registered fleet, the latest independently resolved live state for each vehicle, and Fleet Operations work orders.

narrative.vehicleMethod: Latest independently resolved state for this registered vehicle.
narrative.workOrderMethod: Open high- or critical-severity Fleet Operations work order.
narrative.whatChanged: {{online}} of {{total}} registered vehicles have live state; {{ready}} are departure ready and {{urgent}} urgent work orders remain open.
narrative.readyImpact: Current connectivity, charge level, software posture, and service status support fleet dispatch decisions.
narrative.liveBasis: Live state resolved for {{online}} of {{total}} registered vehicles.
narrative.workOrderLimitedBasis: Fleet Operations work orders were unavailable.
narrative.workOrderBasis: {{count}} open work orders were evaluated for service attention.
narrative.serviceResponse: Review the urgent Fleet Operations work orders before assigning affected vehicles.
narrative.connectivityResponse: Verify connectivity before issuing commands to vehicles without live state.
narrative.chargeResponse: Confirm charging plans for vehicles below the departure-readiness threshold.
narrative.monitorResponse: No immediate fleet response is indicated; continue monitoring readiness and service status.
narrative.snapshotLimitation: Live vehicle state is a current snapshot and does not explain why a vehicle is offline or at a low charge level.
narrative.workOrderLimitation: Service readiness is incomplete while Fleet Operations work orders are unavailable.
narrative.evidenceLimit: Supporting evidence is limited to four vehicle snapshots and two urgent work orders.
narrative.liveMethod: Resolves current state independently for every registered vehicle.
narrative.serviceMethod: Counts open work orders and elevates high- and critical-severity records.

charging.title: Cost, reliability, and battery-friendly behavior
charging.description: Current charging state, departure readiness, cost exposure, and charger behavior are paired with the selected session history.
charging.currentPostureUnavailable: Live state could not be resolved; session history remains available.
charging.currentPostureIdle: Latest battery state is {{battery}}%; the vehicle is not drawing charge.
charging.currentPostureMissing: Live state has not arrived; session history remains available.
charging.departureUnavailable: Current battery state is required to assess near-term departure readiness.
charging.departureEta: Estimated {{duration}} to the configured charge target.
charging.departureReady: Battery state supports near-term departure; confirm route range before leaving.
charging.departureLow: Additional charging is recommended before the next departure.
charging.departureAttentionDescription: Charge before the next departure or confirm that the planned route is within the available range.
charging.costExposureUnavailable: A blended rate requires both recorded energy and cost.
charging.efficiencyNotMeasuredDetail: Independent wall-input and battery-retained energy are not present in the session contract; delivery rate is shown below instead.
charging.interruptionsDetail: Sessions with a telemetry gap or sustained unexpectedly low DC power.
charging.reliabilityDetail: Share of sessions without telemetry gaps, sustained low power, or prolonged trickle behavior; not a charger-uptime SLA.
charging.liveStateUnavailableTitle: Live charging and departure state are unavailable
charging.liveStateUnavailableDescription: Charging history and cost analysis remain available, but current battery and charging posture could not be resolved.
charging.anomalyDescription: Review the session evidence and charger conditions before the pattern repeats.
charging.noDataTitle: No charging activity in this window
charging.noDataDescription: Choose a wider analysis window or complete a charging session.
charging.sessionsDetail: Completed and active sessions in the selected period.
charging.energyDetail: Total energy added across the selected sessions.
charging.costDetail: Recorded charging spend in the active period.
charging.exceptionsDetail: Sessions with missing telemetry, unusual cost, power, or duration.
charging.provenance: Derived from live vehicle state, charging-session telemetry, configured cost data, and vehicle-local day boundaries.

narrative.anomalyMethod: Session matched a deterministic telemetry, power, duration, or cost exception rule.
narrative.sessionMethod: Direct charging-session energy, time, and location record.
narrative.whatChanged: {{sessions}} sessions delivered {{energy}} in the selected window; {{exceptions}} require review.
narrative.impact: Current charge posture and repeated session exceptions affect departure readiness, cost visibility, and charger confidence.
narrative.sessionBasis: {{count}} sessions were evaluated in the active period.
narrative.liveLimitedBasis: Live charging and battery state could not be resolved.
narrative.liveBasis: Current charging and battery state comes from the live vehicle-state record.
narrative.monitorResponse: No immediate response is indicated; continue monitoring departure readiness and session exceptions.
narrative.reliabilityLimitation: The clear-session ratio is an exception heuristic, not a charger-uptime service level.
narrative.liveLimitation: Departure readiness is incomplete while live vehicle state is unavailable.
narrative.causeLimitation: Session patterns do not establish whether the vehicle, charger, site, or network caused an exception.
narrative.liveMethod: Provides current battery level, charging state, and estimated time to target.
narrative.historyMethod: Evaluates recorded sessions for energy, cost, duration, power, and telemetry exceptions.

fleetNarrative.sessionMethod: Direct business-account charging session returned by Tesla Fleet Charging.
fleetNarrative.whatChanged: {{sessions}} Fleet Charging sessions delivered {{energy}} with {{cost}} in recorded fees.
fleetNarrative.impact: Business-account session records provide auditable site, energy, fee, and charger evidence for fleet cost review.
fleetNarrative.sessionBasis: {{count}} direct Fleet Charging sessions match the active filters.
fleetNarrative.costBasis: Every matching session includes a recorded cost.
fleetNarrative.monitorResponse: No immediate response is indicated; continue reviewing site costs and newly synchronized sessions.
fleetNarrative.accountLimitation: This source is available only to eligible Tesla business accounts.
fleetNarrative.missingCostLimitation: Cost totals exclude sessions without a fee supplied by Tesla.
fleetNarrative.causeLimitation: Session records show observed energy and fees but do not diagnose the cause of charging behavior.
fleetNarrative.evidenceLimit: Supporting evidence is limited to the five most recent sessions matching the active filters.
fleetNarrative.sourceMethod: Aggregates energy, direct Tesla fee fields, charger type, and site from synchronized business-account sessions.

drives.title: Activity, efficiency, and exceptions in context
drives.description: Measured energy, route context, and exceptions use one vehicle-aware period with direct access to supporting evidence.
drives.anomalyDescription: Review measured high-energy drives against route, speed, temperature, and battery context.
drives.partialEnergyDescription: Activity remains visible, but efficiency requires measured energy and at least 1 km of distance.
drives.noDataTitle: No drives in this analysis window
drives.noDataDescription: Choose a wider window or complete a drive to build an operating baseline.
drives.countDetail: Completed drives in the selected analysis window.
drives.distanceDetail: Total distance traveled using the current display unit.
drives.efficiencyDetail: {{measured}} of {{total}} drives have measured energy and sufficient distance.
drives.movementDetail: Distance-weighted energy intensity compared with the prior period.
drives.exceptionDetail: Measured drives in the high energy-intensity grade.
drives.routeCoverageDetail: {{covered}} of {{total}} drives include both origin and destination evidence.
drives.provenance: Measured energy and distance stay canonical until display; missing evidence is excluded rather than estimated.

narrative.exceptionMethod: Measured energy intensity matched the deterministic exception grade.
narrative.driveMethod: Direct completed-drive distance, energy, and route record.
narrative.whatChanged: {{drives}} drives covered {{distance}} at {{efficiency}} average energy intensity; {{exceptions}} records were flagged.
narrative.impact: Measured energy intensity and route coverage reveal operational exceptions without guessing at their cause.
narrative.energyBasis: {{measured}} of {{total}} drives include measured energy and sufficient distance.
narrative.comparisonBasis: The immediately preceding period provides a measured comparison baseline.
narrative.comparisonLimitedBasis: A comparable preceding-period energy baseline is unavailable.
narrative.monitorResponse: No immediate response is indicated; continue monitoring energy intensity as more drives complete.
narrative.energyLimitation: {{count}} drive records are excluded from efficiency because measured energy or sufficient distance is missing.
narrative.routeLimitation: {{count}} drive records lack complete origin and destination evidence.
narrative.causeLimitation: Drive records do not isolate weather, traffic, payload, HVAC use, or road grade as a cause.
narrative.evidenceLimit: Supporting evidence is limited to five exception or recent-drive records.
narrative.historyMethod: Aggregates completed-drive distance and measured energy in canonical units, excluding incomplete efficiency records.

alerts.title: Triage, ownership, and evidence in one queue
alerts.description: Open issues are separated from acknowledged work, with direct access to the triggering signal and response history.
alerts.criticalDescription: Inspect the related signal, record an owner, and acknowledge the response.
alerts.agingDescription: The oldest unacknowledged alert has been open for {{count}} hours.
alerts.evidenceDescription: {{count}} open alert has no related signal metadata; use its source and timestamp to investigate.
alerts.openDetail: Awaiting acknowledgement or a recorded response.
alerts.acknowledgedDetail: Items with a recorded response in this scope.
alerts.respondersDetail: Named owners recorded by acknowledgement events.
alerts.provenance: Derived from the alert event feed, rule metadata, and acknowledgement audit records for the active vehicle and date scope.

narrative.openImpact: Unacknowledged alerts can leave vehicle or fleet conditions without a recorded response.
narrative.clearImpact: No alert in the selected scope is waiting for acknowledgement.
narrative.confidenceRecord: Alert state comes from direct persisted event records.
narrative.confidenceAudit: Acknowledgement ownership comes from the server audit record.
narrative.rootCauseLimitation: Alert records show triggers and response state; they do not prove root cause.
narrative.missingSignalLimitation: {{count}} open alert lacks related signal metadata.
narrative.evidenceCap: The evidence preview shows the 5 most recent records from this scope.
narrative.noResponse: No immediate response is required; continue monitoring the selected scope.
narrative.scopeMethod: Filtered to the active vehicle and analysis window.

alerts.auditUnavailable: The alert summary is available, but its audit trail has not loaded.
alerts.cachedAuditWarning: The latest refresh failed. Showing the most recent cached audit trail.
alerts.rulesUnavailable: Alert events remain available, but rule status could not be loaded.
alerts.feedUnavailableDetail: Restore the alert feed to resume triage.

remediation.battery: Confirm the current state of charge and charging access. Schedule charging if the condition persists.
remediation.charging: Review charging telemetry, connector state, and recent interruptions before the next session.
remediation.tire: Inspect tire pressure and temperature before the next drive, then confirm the reading after adjustment.
remediation.security: Verify vehicle location and access state before acknowledging the event.
remediation.software: Review update readiness and schedule installation while the vehicle is safely parked.
remediation.system: Open diagnostics and verify the affected service before acknowledging the incident.
remediation.driving: Review the related drive and telemetry window, then record any required operator follow-up.
remediation.signal: Inspect the related signal around the trigger time and record the response when acknowledging.
remediation.general: Review the alert source, timestamp, and audit history before acknowledging the response.
